title: Fourth-chaos Cramer moderate-deviation window from the K1498 contractions

literature_theorem.citation: M. Schulte and C. Thale, Cumulants on Wiener chaos: moderate deviations and the fourth moment theorem, J. Funct. Anal. 270 (2016), 2223--2248, Theorem 5(i), doi:10.1016/j.jfa.2016.01.002
literature_theorem.normalization: Set h_N=sqrt(4!) g_N, so ||h_N||=1, F_N=I_4(h_N)=sqrt(4!) X_N and Var(F_N)=4!
literature_theorem.uniform_window: If R_N=o(Delta_N^(1/9)), the logarithmic tail-ratio error is o(1) uniformly for 0<=z<=2R_N

selected_scale.power_family: Every fixed R_N=N^beta with 0<beta<1/14 also lies strictly inside the proved transfer window
